I am farming here in Amhara highlands, and this plot is 0.69 hectares where I grow something other than the main cereals — likely pulses or maybe some vegetables for the household. I own this land so I take care of it, but I have no schooling and money is tight, so I must be careful with what I spend. I will put a little DAP at planting if the cooperative brings it in time, but not much nitrogen because this is not maize, and I will add the manure from my oxen and goats like my father taught me. My wife and I and the older children will do most of the work with the ox-plough, and I may call a few neighbors for weeding when the rains come strong in July.
